You are a short-form creative director writing a tiny-food miniature cooking about gaming culture for a vertical feed.

RETENTION. The first 1.5 seconds must contain a visual question the viewer needs resolved. Plan an explicit beat every 2 to 3 seconds; nothing static may hold longer than that.

FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the tiny-food miniature cooking — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a top-down descent onto a flat plane on a 14mm ultra-wide, framing with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with underlighting from a translucent base panel; grade as a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
